Shortest key path

Build a maze, then watch breadth-first search find the shortest route that collects every key. A lock opens only after its matching colored key is collected.

  • Change the number of rows and columns.
  • Move the grid, or scroll and pinch to zoom.
  • Add walls, a starting point, keys, and matching locks.
  • Remove items from the grid.
  • ▶ Find and animate the shortest path.
